specs.name: 主角极简
specs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished portrait mobile-game homepage concept, full bleed, approximately 9:19.5 aspect ratio, ideally 1024 x 2176 pixels, with no phone frame, no presentation board, no extra panels. This is a redesign of the existing Chinese game 泡泡小队. Image 1 is the current game homepage: preserve its game identity, the existing felt-flowerpot animals, material style and functional scope, while redesigning the ENTIRE composition. Image 2 is a reference sheet of the actual game's characters: preserve their identities and tactile fur/felt textures. Image 3 is a competitor reference ONLY for broad composition, never copy their characters, branding, or extra functions.
Art direction: premium charming plush toy 3D game art, fuzzy fibers and felt stitching clearly visible, large lively eyes, soft toy-like volume, creamy highlights, subtle shadows, polished pill buttons with real depth. Our mascot is the BLUE teddy bear with cream muzzle and round ears emerging from a BLUE felt pot with paw/cloud decorations and two green leaves. Other partners: GREEN frog in a green heart-pattern pot; sleepy ORANGE capybara with brown broad muzzle in orange felt pot; YELLOW chick in yellow flower pot; PURPLE elephant with pink ears in purple flower pot. Animals stay in their pots, do not add human torsos or legs. The PEACH rabbit in a peach daisy pot is the next partner. Preserve designs from reference, not generic substitute mascots.
Functional scope: ONLY a small settings gear at the very upper LEFT inside a safe margin (top about 3%, not floating down near title); game title; ONE dominant yellow/cream rounded Start button with the level number integrated inside it; ONE smaller collection/album entry; ONE light next-partner teaser with peach rabbit. Leave upper-right clear for platform controls. No coins, energy, rankings, shops, events, sign-in, skins, extra navigation, fake progress counters, third-party logos or watermarks. Do not add more buttons than specified.
Exact readable Chinese text: title “泡泡小队”; optional subtitle “毛绒伙伴 · 一起出发”; settings “设置”; big CTA “开始游戏” with smaller “第5关” inside the same button; album “图鉴”; teaser “新伙伴 小霞” and “通关这一关就来啦！”. Use large clear rounded game lettering, precise Chinese, comfortable empty space, clean hierarchy, thumb-friendly bottom CTA. Do not include concept names A/B/C/D or explanatory captions inside the image.
CONCEPT A — hero-led minimal composition inspired by reference 3's large mascot (the ant screenshot). A quiet, airy pale lavender-to-creamy-lilac background with an extremely subtle tone-on-tone embossed bubble/paw repeat, not a landscape. A medium-large cream white title outlined purple centered in the upper 15–22%; small restrained subtitle below. A SINGLE enormous blue plush bear in its felt pot is the charismatic hero, occupying the middle 30–68%, slightly tilted and looking toward a delicate iridescent soap bubble it has blown toward upper-right. The bear should have a playful expression, nuanced fur and a soft grounded shadow. Only a few widely spaced tiny bubbles; no busy confetti. Large pill yellow start button centered around 80–87% of screen, about 62% screen width. Album button to its lower-right, smaller and visually secondary. At 92–96% a slim unboxed next-partner teaser with tiny peach rabbit bubble on left and two short text lines on right. Everything reads immediately. Modern, simple, warm, very easy to implement.

CONCEPT B — cozy isometric toy-room diorama inspired by the reference 3 room screenshot. Change the whole homepage into a tiny handcrafted felt playroom, with powder blue outer background, cream walls, lilac trims and warm honey wood/felt floor. Compact rounded fabric title near the top at 14–21%. The main composition from 27–72% is a small open-front isometric ROOM, with two low walls, one big rounded window, a low soft toy shelf, a little knitted oval rug, and one cushioned bench, with generous blank corners. Five of OUR pot animals inhabit this cozy diorama: blue bear pot in the front-center on the rug, green frog and purple elephant beside it, orange capybara and yellow chick at the rear near the low bench. They should be large enough to read as our furry characters and not tiny room props. This is a character welcome room, not a furniture-building game: no decorating affordances, no room progress bar, no furniture buttons. Small album entry is a cream book-shaped badge tucked just below the room on the left. Start button is centered below the room around 81–89%, broad, sunny yellow with plush cream rim, level integrated. A small centered next-rabbit teaser is under it near 94%. Every part of the room uses believable felt, fleece and soft rounded wood textures. The whole page feels inviting and spacious, with beautiful isometric depth and a strong clear entry to play.

CONCEPT C — bold title and ensemble launch composition inspired by the competitor's large title and central game object. Background is luminous lavender with a restrained pearly center gradient and soft curved bands. A much larger playful logo “泡泡小队” occupying 15–29%, crafted as chunky cream and pastel felt letters with rich purple edge and stitched extrusion, one small transparent bubble nestled at a letter corner. Main hero scene is a close FIVE-PARTNER GROUP PORTRAIT on a soft three-level cloud-shaped lavender cushion podium: blue bear largest foreground center, frog left, elephant right, capybara and chick peeking behind. This group fills 34–69%; dense attractive character mass with clear silhouettes and friendly expression, NOT a grid and NOT separated floating portraits. One or two iridescent bubbles give motion. A clean cream-colored bottom dock with softly rounded top corners occupies the final 23% of the screen. Within it, top line is a compact next-partner strip with small peach rabbit, “新伙伴 小霞” and “通关这一关就来啦！”. Below it, the large yellow start button occupies roughly 70% width with “开始游戏 / 第5关”; a discrete lavender album button occupies the remaining right side. Keep dock elegant and shallow, rather than a giant panel. Settings near top-left stays out of the logo. Strong game branding, ensemble identity and a deliberate bottom action zone distinguish this design.

CONCEPT D — playful gameplay showcase with diagonal bubble motion, strongly different from a standing ensemble or room. Palette transitions from soft sky blue at top to pale lilac at bottom, with a little cream and yellow. Upper title “泡泡小队” centered at 15–23% is medium-large, white/cream rounded dimensional letters with a violet edge. In the central 29–66%, an attractive floating HEART MOSAIC made of hundreds of small glossy round blue, pink and yellow beads forms the main puzzle object; use smooth spherical beads, not cubes or cubes that mimic the competitor. A sweeping thin curved stream of a few glossy bubbles leads diagonally from a large BLUE plush bear in its blue felt pot in the lower-left of the hero area toward the heart's upper-right. The GREEN frog and ORANGE capybara pots appear smaller on the right on small lavender cushion pedestals, looking toward the colorful bead heart. Keep the heart composition decorative, no crosshair, no live battle HUD, no ammunition numbers. Plenty of empty air around the diagonal action. Put ONE album button as a small cream book badge on the right around 66%, visually separate from the large bottom centered yellow start button at 79–87%. Show the next peach rabbit in a translucent soap bubble accompanied by its short teaser at 91–95%. Overall feeling is a toy bubble playground: clearly communicates bubble-clearing gameplay while keeping the real game's plush cast, with premium light, restrained sparkle, and highly readable actions.

revisionA: 保留原有字体、按钮、配色和底部小兔预告；移除主场景的水豚、小鸡、青蛙、大象，让蓝熊单独成为主视觉，减少背景纹样。
